relations: A bright fireball erupts at the parked truck's location, expanding into a rounded blast cloud.
Truck debris, including wheels and cab panels, scatters radially outward and upward from the blast center.
The expanding dust cloud thickens and obscures the truck's original position as the fire fades.
The camera framing remains constant, fixing the explosion's center at the truck's initial ground location.
caption: On a flat, pale desert plain beneath a clear blue sky, a low mountain range stretches across the horizon and a small white cloud floats at the left. A white semi-truck tractor unit sits parked near the center, its cab, exposed chassis, and wheels intact with no trailer attached. A large gray-brown dust cloud hangs over the right-middle background, drifting slowly while the truck remains still. A bright orange-white fireball erupts at the truck's location, obscuring the cab and expanding upward and outward into a rounded blast cloud as dark fragments scatter radially into the sky. The luminous fire fades into a turbulent tan-and-white dust cloud that keeps growing, while larger debris—cab panels, wheels, and dark chunks—tumble and fly outward and upward. A light-colored panel arcs high through the air, and wheels roll across the ground at the right as parts translate away from the blast center and fall. The dust cloud thickens and spreads across the original truck position, becoming the dominant feature, while the background cloud persists and merges with the new blast cloud. The camera framing and background positions remain constant, fixing the explosion's center at the truck's original ground location.
